about: The entry mark of the tech role set (pipeline/roles_tech.py, entry()): who enters at a posting. 'grad' marks a posting written for students or new graduates (bachelor's, master's or PhD; Cornell Tech's MEng and MS students are new graduates in this sense); no mark means an experienced hire or no evidence. A firm row gives the title at which an employer hires its graduates, and enters this file only with its source (as in entry_mba.json); there are none yet.

title.note: Words in a title. 'not_for_them' stops every rule (a job about students is not a job for them). 'intern' sets intern and marks the posting grad: an internship is for students. 'grad' names new graduates outright.

text.note: Read only on the levels listed, where the title gives no audience: a line that says the posting is for students or new graduates marks it grad.
